bulletPoints: BOQ & Quantity Estimation: Prepared detailed measurement sheets and abstract costing for 90+ work items using CPWD SOR and project-specific Rate Analysis, quantifying 177.54 cum excavation, 455.73 cum RCC M25, and over 2500 sqm of finishes on the CPF Gandhar Electrical Office Building.

Cost Deviation Analysis: Prepared deviation statements comparing estimated vs. tendered rates across multiple RAs, verified Rate Analysis using site measurement records against contractual rates, and tracked variations across structures & finishes.

Quality Assurance & Standards: Applied IS Code protocols (IS 456, IS 10262, IS 3495, IS 1786) for material testing; reviewed non-destructive test (NDT) reports and maintenance logs against project specifications.

Drawing to Site Execution: Interpreted Architectural and Structural GFC drawings for execution sequencing and MEP coordination; monitored formwork, PCC/RCC concreting, and reinforcement activities on site.
Plant Infrastructure Integration: Observed the integration of crude oil headers, firefighting systems, and drainage networks within civil designs in an active hydrocarbon facility.
